Statistical fixtures (paired/clustered, zero-event bounds, screening/sequential stopping, threshold immutability) are IMP-11's analysis substrate; deferred to land with their consumer.

Two materially different synthetic book profiles (research/explanation-heavy vs example-heavy) exercise the ontology along different axes; four-stratum chapter sets are representable via the fxPacket override hook.
Semantic assertions/hashes/ids/schemas throughout; the one prompt snapshot (author card) is an intentional contract surface. Anti-hard-code scan: zero zz-* ids in production source.

Tests are deterministic and parallel-safe (pid+seq-unique roots, no Date.now/random in fixtures); dispose() + OS tmpdir handle abrupt termination; stale cleanup covered by sweepStaleAttempts/sweepStaleExecDirs (IMP-00/01).

Non-network package entry points: contract-validate, test:hermetic, ci (typecheck→contract-validate→test). Outer-monorepo root CI wiring is out of scope for a no-push package and needs explicit owner coordination.
TEST-ARCHITECTURE.md documents entry points, the hermeticity model + legacy-leak baseline + closing recipe, injected roots, fixtures, and how incidents become fixtures / how contract versions evolve.

unresolvedRisks: The suite is not yet FULLY hermetic (F-018): pre-IMP-12 tests (autopilot, qc-converge, stier-levers, stier2-levers, research-freshness, and others) mutate pipeline state/logs/.attempts via default roots. The leak guard now makes this VISIBLE and CI-checkable (test:hermetic exits 1); the always-on gate is scoped to the already-clean forbidden shadow. Closing the legacy offenders onto mkTestRoots() is incremental follow-on. Every NEW test in this package is hermetic.

Judge-qualification and statistical fixtures (items 14-15) are deferred to IMP-11 (their consumer does not exist yet); clone/shadow-diversity fixtures (item 13) to IMP-06. Deferring avoids freezing an interface before its consumer per the plan's contract-change rule.
Outer-monorepo root CI wiring (item 19) is provided as package entry points only; editing the outer repo's CI is out of scope for a no-push package.
The full leak guard cannot become an always-on suite gate until the legacy offenders are closed; until then it is the opt-in ratchet (test:hermetic).
